info.name: Create a new governed, protected, tokenized, or fpe column

items.docs: This endpoint can be used to govern or detokenize a column in a view or table, or to protect, govern or detokenize a column in a table. Protect is only available for non-SFCI Databases. Tokenized is only available for SFCI Databases.

items.docs:
Converts a governed column to protect, tokenized, or fpe. A tokenized column to govern, protect, or fpe. A fpe column to govern, protect, or tokenized.
Can also be used to update a field's friendlyName if desired. Can also update alphabet, keyName, or tweakName if column is fpe.

Set 'reinvoke' to true to retry a failed column connection.

items.docs:
Deletes a govern, protected, tokenized, or fpe data field by its corresponding ID.

If the field provided is currently in a scattered state a job will be queued and the field will be set to a removal_pending state and eventually from the database. 

If the field provided is in a governed-only state then the field will be removed immediately.

params.description: Filter by the masking policies name.

items.docs:
If the `fieldId`` passed is a valid Snowflake CI Column, you will get a result of all the available masking policies that can applied for this column.

If the `fieldId`` passed is not a Snowflake CI Column, you will always get the default masking policy type of 0, No Mask.
